mapper.select: SELECT service, code, value::text AS value FROM parameter_override WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parameter_override (id, tenant_id, service, code, value, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{service}, #{code}, CAST(#{value} AS jsonb), now(), now(), #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service, code) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{actor}
mapper.update: UPDATE parameter_override SET deleted = true, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND service = #{service} AND code = #{code} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE parameter_override SET deleted = true, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
